checks.detail: Three continuous column containers, adjacent rows with zero gap, no row shadow/border/radius.
Delete immediately follows Edit; Task information, ID and timestamps are absent.
Delete still requires explicit inline confirmation; Cancel preserves the Task and restores Delete focus.
Workspace form has direct selection/description, Add/Remove only; no visible count, Edit/Done or source-mode buttons.
Add supports another workspace and optional description; folder path is selected through the same native selector, not a mode switch.
Simplified Project form has no horizontal overflow at 390×844.
Simplified Project form saves through the existing session-only path and returns to the Project.
At 390×844 Edit and Delete stay adjacent, visible, and within the viewport.
No console errors in the final simplified candidate review tab.

boundaries: Voice and files retain Round 4 simulation boundaries.
Earlier List/Board, separate-card, compact-workspace and Task-information alternatives are superseded.
No production/backend/source writes; no full Product approval or handoff.
